claims.text: An 8-year-old girl presented with a 7-month history of indurated plaques of the lower leg. A bluish-red limited skin hardening with itching had developed in December 2021; antihistamines and later local aclometasone cream brought no improvement, and joint and muscle pain of both legs began four months after the skin lesions appeared. Both parents had chronic Lyme disease.
